verdict.rationale: smolagents provides agent.replay() and memory access for reviewing past agent steps, and push_to_hub/from_hub lets you save and reload agent configurations via Hugging Face Hub repos (which are git-backed, implying some version history), but there is no documented explicit versioning, diff/review workflow, or rollback mechanism for automations themselves. Missing for 10: explicit version history/diff tooling for agent definitions, a documented rollback command, and any review workflow beyond replaying execution steps.
